title: Fritz!Exporter Overview
description: Every metric of the Fritz! exporter, grouped by topic. Rows that do not apply to a device (cable on a DSL box, ...) stay empty.

panels.title: New Fritz!OS
panels.description: The version of an available update; empty when there is none.

panels.title: Read problems
panels.description: Metric groups the exporter could not read in full in the last scrape.

panels.title: Read problems
panels.description: partial = some values or items, skipped = the whole group, error = a bug in the exporter. The log has the details.

panels.title: Completed scrapes
panels.description: Scrapes of this device per minute.

panels.title: Exporter: timed out and failed scrapes
panels.description: For the whole exporter, not per device.

panels.title: Current data rate
panels.description: As reported by the device (fritz_wan_datarate_bytes); upload is drawn below.

panels.title: Traffic from the byte counters
panels.description: rate() of fritz_wan_data_bytes_total: the average over the interval.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: All WAN connections from the REST API, also the disabled ones.

panels.title: Downstream sync / attainable
panels.description: How much of the attainable rate the line is synced at.

panels.title: Upstream sync / attainable
panels.description: How much of the attainable rate the line is synced at.

panels.title: Noise margin
panels.description: Higher is better; below about 6 dB the line may drop.

panels.title: Shared segment utilization
panels.description: own = this box, total = everyone on the segment. Cable boxes only.

panels.title: Connection rate
panels.description: As the device reports it; the unit differs between models.

targets.expr: sum by (interface) (label_replace(fritz_host_active{friendly_name="$device"} * on (serial, mac_address) group_left (interface) fritz_host_info{friendly_name="$device"}, "interface", "unknown", "interface", "(|n/a)"))
